package.description: Control a Lenovo ThinkVision P32p-20 monitor from Windows over DDC/CI - brightness, contrast, input, colour modes, presets and hotkeys. Unofficial.

en-US.author: MrErrorSan
en-US.description: Control a Lenovo ThinkVision P32p-20 monitor from Windows over DDC/CI - brightness, contrast, input, colour modes, presets and hotkeys. Unofficial.
en-US.longDescription:
ThinkVision Control is an unofficial app that controls a Lenovo ThinkVision P32p-20 from the computer instead of its buttons, over DDC/CI.
It puts the whole on-screen menu in one small window: input switching (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C), brightness and contrast, Day and Night presets, colour mode, Over Drive, Dynamic Contrast, aspect ratio, USB charging, menu language and resets.
It adds global keyboard shortcuts with an on-screen indicator, a tray menu, automatic Day/Night at set times or at sunrise and sunset, a "Switch to this PC" action for monitors shared between two computers, a command line (--preset, --input, --step, --get) and thinkvision:// links.
Not affiliated with Lenovo. Lenovo and ThinkVision are trademarks of Lenovo.
en-US.name: ThinkVision Control
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed: the app didn't start on some Windows PCs. 0.0.5 and 0.0.6 needed the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable, which a fresh Windows doesn't have; the program now carries everything it needs.
Releases are now built by GitHub Actions from the tagged source.
